They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city.
They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses.
The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family.
They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.
Pebble Spring watched the masons at work.
They studied every beam and brick.
They admired the curved rooftops.
They listened to stories by the hearth.
They sketched doors in soft chalk.
They measured windows with a staff.
They planned paths through the garden.
They built walls with earth and stone.
They tested roofs against the wind.
They learned patience from the elders.
They learned balance from the trees.
They dreamed of a warm cottage.
They placed stones with gentle magic.
They raised a trial wall at dawn.
They opened the first wooden door.
They placed the first roof beam.
They lit the first small hearth.
They invited the neighbors to look.
They felt proud of their new craft.
Pebble Spring learned housebuilding from the old city masons and from the wise tree spirits who taught them about stones bricks beams roofs doors windows floors walls foundations paths gardens fire water light air spotty weather.
